chapterInfo.content:
23
AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ ɛnyɛ nhyia kronkron, m’afahyɛ nna no nie.
3 # Eks 20.8-11 Nnansia na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ home mu homeda, wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛyɛ AWURADE homeda mo tenabea nyinaa mu.
4 # Eks 23.14-19 Yeinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ, nhyia kronkron a mompae ne mmerɛ mu no:
5 # Eks 12 Bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ yɛ AWURADE twam; 6na bosome no ara da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ AWURADE apiti afahyɛ, nnanson na monni apiti. 7Da a ɛdi kan no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara. 8Na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE nnanson; da a ɛtɔ so nson no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
9Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 10Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so na motwa ɛso nnɔbaeɛ a, momfa mo nnɔbaeɛ fi a ɛdi kan no mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ; 11#Mat 28.1; 1 Ko 15.20 na ɔnhim efi no AWURADE anim, na ɛnsɔ ani mma mo; homeda no, adeɛ kye a, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim. 12Na ɛda a mohim efi no, momfa odwanten ba a ɔdi mu a wadi afe mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE, 13ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre, na ɛnyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ne ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako. 14Na monnni paanoo anaa ayuo a wɔato anaasɛ wɔasie kɔsi da no ara a mode mo Nyankopɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ reba no. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.
15 # Eks 23.16; 34.22; Num 28.26-31; Deut 16.9-12 Na monkan nna mfa mfiri homeda no akyiri da, da a mode ohim fi no ba no ɛnyɛ nnawɔtwe nson pɛpɛɛpɛ. 16Monkan adaduonum nkɔsi homeda a ɛtɔ so nson no akyiri da so ansa na mode aduane afɔdeɛ foforɔ abrɛ AWURADE. 17Momfa ohim paanoo mmienu mfiri mo tenabea mmra; esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu mmɔreka na wɔmfa nto, na ɛnyɛ aduanekan mma AWURADE. 18Na momfa nnwanten mma nson a wɔdi mu a wɔadi afe afe ne nantwiburuwa baako ne adwennini mmienu nka paanoo no ho; wɔnyɛ AWURADE ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE. 19Na momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe mmɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. 20Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim wɔn ne aduanekan paanoo no ne nnwanten mma mmienu no na ɛnyɛ AWURADE anim ohim afɔdeɛ: Ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE na wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no. 21Na monhyia da no ara; ɛnyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, monnyɛ adwuma den biara. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo tenabea nyinaa mu, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. 22#Lew 19.9 Na sɛ motwa mo asase so nnɔbaeɛ a, nwie w’afuo nkwanseɛ deɛ twa, na nni wo nnɔbaeɛ no mu mpɛpɛ: Gya ma ohiani ne ɔhɔhoɔ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
23Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 24#Num 29.1-6; 10.10 Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛdi kan nyɛ mo homeda, totorobɛntohyɛn nkaeɛ, nhyia kronkron; 25monnyɛ adwumaden biara, na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE.
26Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 27#Lew 16 Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi ara da a ɛtɔ so du ne mpata da; monhyia nhyia kronkron, na mommrɛ mo ho ase na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE. 28Na ɛda no monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ mpata da a wɔpata ma mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim. 29Na obiara a ɔmmrɛ ne ho ase da no no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene. 30Na onipa biara a ɔyɛ adwuma bi saa da no no, mɛsɛe saa onii ko no afiri ne man mu. 31Monnyɛ adwuma biara; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu. 32Ɛyɛ home mu homeda ma mo, na mommrɛ mo ho ase bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nkron no anwummerɛ; monni mo homeda no mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anwummerɛ.
33Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 34#Eks 23.16; 34.22; Num 29.12-39; Deut 16.13-15 Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ asese afahyɛ nnanson ma AWURADE. 35Da a ɛdi kan no yɛ nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara. 36#Yoh 7.37 Nnanson na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no nyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; ɛyɛ afahyɛ awieeɛ, monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
37Yeinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron no, na wɔmfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne kum afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ebiara wɔ ne da mu. 38Ɛsono AWURADE home nna no, na ɛsono mo ayɛyɛdeɛ, na ɛsono mo aboadeɛ nyinaa, na ɛsono mo ayamyi adeɛ nyinaa a mode ma AWURADE no. 39Nso bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so dunum a moreboa asase so nnɔbaeɛ ano no, monni AWURADE nnapɔnna nnanson: Da a ɛdi kan no yɛ homeda, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no yɛ homeda. 40#Neh 8.14-16 Na ɛda a ɛdi kan no, momfa nnua afɛfɛ so adeɛ, ɛberɛ ne nnua kusuu mman ne nsunoa nnua, na mo ani nnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim nnanson. 41Na momfa nni nnapɔnna mma AWURADE, nnanson daa afe. Ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ; bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu na monni nnapɔnna yi. 42Asese mu na montena nnanson, Israel man mma nyinaa ntena asese mu, 43na mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahunu sɛ meyii Israelfoɔ firii Misraim asase soɔ no, asese mu na memaa wɔtenaeɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. 44Na Mose paee AWURADE afahyɛ no kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ ɛnyɛ nhyia kronkron, m’afahyɛ nna no nie.
Nnansia na wɔnyɛ adwuma, na da a ɛtɔ so nson no yɛ home mu homeda, wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛyɛ AWURADE homeda mo tenabea nyinaa mu.
Yeinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ, nhyia kronkron a mompae ne mmerɛ mu no:
Bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no anwummerɛ yɛ AWURADE twam; na bosome no ara da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ AWURADE apiti afahyɛ, nnanson na monni apiti. Da a ɛdi kan no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara. Na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE nnanson; da a ɛtɔ so nson no monhyia nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru asase a mede merema mo no so na motwa ɛso nnɔbaeɛ a, momfa mo nnɔbaeɛ fi a ɛdi kan no mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ; na ɔnhim efi no AWURADE anim, na ɛnsɔ ani mma mo; homeda no, adeɛ kye a, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim. Na ɛda a mohim efi no, momfa odwanten ba a ɔdi mu a wadi afe mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE, ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ, esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu a wɔde ngo afɔre, na ɛnyɛ AWURADE ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ne ɛho ahwiesa, bobesa susutoa abupɛn nnan mu baako. Na monnni paanoo anaa ayuo a wɔato anaasɛ wɔasie kɔsi da no ara a mode mo Nyankopɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ reba no. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu.
Na monkan nna mfa mfiri homeda no akyiri da, da a mode ohim fi no ba no ɛnyɛ nnawɔtwe nson pɛpɛɛpɛ. Monkan adaduonum nkɔsi homeda a ɛtɔ so nson no akyiri da so ansa na mode aduane afɔdeɛ foforɔ abrɛ AWURADE. Momfa ohim paanoo mmienu mfiri mo tenabea mmra; esiam abupɛn du mu mmienu mmɔreka na wɔmfa nto, na ɛnyɛ aduanekan mma AWURADE. Na momfa nnwanten mma nson a wɔdi mu a wɔadi afe afe ne nantwiburuwa baako ne adwennini mmienu nka paanoo no ho; wɔnyɛ AWURADE ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne ɛho aduane afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE. Na momfa ɔpapo baako mmɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne nnwanten mma mmienu a wɔadi afe afe mmɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhim wɔn ne aduanekan paanoo no ne nnwanten mma mmienu no na ɛnyɛ AWURADE anim ohim afɔdeɛ: Ɛnyɛ kronkron mma AWURADE na wɔmfa mma ɔsɔfoɔ no. Na monhyia da no ara; ɛnyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, monnyɛ adwuma den biara. Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo tenabea nyinaa mu, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Na sɛ motwa mo asase so nnɔbaeɛ a, nwie w’afuo nkwanseɛ deɛ twa, na nni wo nnɔbaeɛ no mu mpɛpɛ: Gya ma ohiani ne ɔhɔhoɔ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛdi kan nyɛ mo homeda, totorobɛntohyɛn nkaeɛ, nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara, na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi ara da a ɛtɔ so du ne mpata da; monhyia nhyia kronkron, na mommrɛ mo ho ase na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE. Na ɛda no monnyɛ adwuma biara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ mpata da a wɔpata ma mo, AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim. Na obiara a ɔmmrɛ ne ho ase da no no, wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu atwene. Na onipa biara a ɔyɛ adwuma bi saa da no no, mɛsɛe saa onii ko no afiri ne man mu. Monnyɛ adwuma biara; ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ, mo tenabea nyinaa mu. Ɛyɛ home mu homeda ma mo, na mommrɛ mo ho ase bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nkron no anwummerɛ; monni mo homeda no mfiri anwummerɛ nkɔsi anwummerɛ.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Bosome a ɛtɔ so nson yi da a ɛtɔ so dunum no yɛ asese afahyɛ nnanson ma AWURADE. Da a ɛdi kan no yɛ nhyia kronkron; monnyɛ adwumaden biara. Nnanson na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no nyɛ mo nhyia kronkron, na momfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE; ɛyɛ afahyɛ awieeɛ, monnyɛ adwumaden biara.
Yeinom ne AWURADE afahyɛ ahodoɔ a mompae sɛ wɔnhyia nhyia kronkron no, na wɔmfa ogya afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne kum afɔdeɛ ne ahwiesa, ebiara wɔ ne da mu. Ɛsono AWURADE home nna no, na ɛsono mo ayɛyɛdeɛ, na ɛsono mo aboadeɛ nyinaa, na ɛsono mo ayamyi adeɛ nyinaa a mode ma AWURADE no. Nso bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so dunum a moreboa asase so nnɔbaeɛ ano no, monni AWURADE nnapɔnna nnanson: Da a ɛdi kan no yɛ homeda, na ɛda a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no yɛ homeda. Na ɛda a ɛdi kan no, momfa nnua afɛfɛ so adeɛ, ɛberɛ ne nnua kusuu mman ne nsunoa nnua, na mo ani nnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn anim nnanson. Na momfa nni nnapɔnna mma AWURADE, nnanson daa afe. Ɛyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ma mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ; bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu na monni nnapɔnna yi. Asese mu na montena nnanson, Israel man mma nyinaa ntena asese mu, na mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahunu sɛ meyii Israelfoɔ firii Misraim asase soɔ no, asese mu na memaa wɔtenaeɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Na Mose paee AWURADE afahyɛ no kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
